faqs.question: How does the Giddh Partnership Program work?
faqs.answer: Join the program, refer businesses to Giddh, and earn commissions whenever your referrals purchase a plan. Our team handles demos, onboarding, and customer support.

faqs.question: What commission do partners earn?
faqs.answer:
• 50% of the amount received upon successful onboarding of the client
• 30% on the second-year renewal
• 20% on the third consecutive year renewal for the same client

faqs.question: Is there any cost to join the program?
faqs.answer: No. The Giddh Partnership Program is completely free to join with no setup fees or hidden charges.

faqs.question: Who handles product demos and customer onboarding?
faqs.answer: The Giddh team takes care of product demos, onboarding, training, and ongoing support for referred customers.

faqs.question: When are commissions paid?
faqs.answer: Commissions are processed quarterly after successful payment is received from the referred customer.
